name: python-fenwick-tree
title: Fenwick Cells
blurb: A binary indexed tree over integer values: point adds climb the lowest bit, prefix and range sums walk it back, and every answer is checked against the running list-sum reference the walk visits at most bit-length(n) cells.
default_description: A binary indexed tree whose adds and prefixes walk the lowest set bit, answering every prefix exactly as the running list-sum reference does.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
